user.title: Lhotka Swimming Pool
user.description: This integration reads publicly available data from koupaliste-lhotka.cz — water and air temperature, occupancy and opening hours. No login required.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach koupaliste-lhotka.cz. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_response: The website responded but the expected data was not found. The page structure has probably changed — please open an issue.

abort.already_configured: The integration is already set up.

init.title: Settings
init.description: How often to read temperatures and occupancy. Opening hours are refreshed every 6 hours regardless of this setting.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: 10 minutes is recommended. Shorter intervals put load on a third-party website without providing fresher data.
